name: locking-gpus
description: Run GPU jobs under a per-GPU flock (~/.gpu_locks/<N>) with HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES set, so concurrent agents and benchmarks on a shared multi-GPU machine never share a GPU.

interface.shortDescription: Per-GPU flock so benchmarks never share a GPU
defaultPrompt: Benchmark this kernel on a free GPU.
Compare the before and after builds on the same locked GPU.
